# Map Shows Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State 2 Months Until Midterms

Published

Sep 03, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

updated

Sep 03, 2026 at 12:34 PM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

With two months to go until Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections, new polling shows President Donald Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term.

The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on August 31, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

# Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state.

results.content:
The president’s popularity differs across the country.

According to Civiqs' online polling, as of late August, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 percent disapprove.

The president’s weakest numbers can be found in Democratic strongholds. His approval rating is weakest in Hawaii, where 18 percent approve of his job performance, and 81 percent disapprove. [...] Since taking office in January 2025, however, Trump's overall approval rating has remained underwater nationally. Polling has continually showed lost ground with demographic groups that were key to his success in 2024, including young people.

AP News' poll from the Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research says Trump's approval rating stands at 66% against and 33% for him as of July 23.
 Fox News' poll says Trump stands at 61% against and 39% for as of July 17-20.
 Reuters/Ipsos' poll says Trump stands at 63% disapproval, 33% approval as of Aug. 28-31.
 Civiqs' national polling says Trump stands at 59% against and 36% for with 6% undecided as of Aug. 31. [...] The New York Times averages several other polls daily. Its data says Trump stands at 58% disapproval and 38% approval as of Sept. 1.
 Silver Bulletin's poll shows 58% disapprove and 38.2% approve as of Sept. 1.
